newsitem.title: FRANCE: France holds two suspected Algerian guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: France holds two suspected Algerian guerrillas.

text.p: A French investigating magistrate on Monday remanded two Algerian-born men in custody on suspicion of involvement in terrorist activities, justice sources said.
They said police found pistols, ammunition and explosives at the home of Aziz Hamkiden and Lunes Tidadini during a criminal probe in the eastern town of Besancon.
They also found propaganda for the Islamic Salvation Front (FIS) Moslem fundamentalist movement which is fighting the Algerian government.
Anti-terrorist judge Laurence Le Vert placed the two men under investigation on suspicion of belonging to an illegal group involved in terrorist activities.
France was shaken last year by a wave of bombings blamed on the Algerian Islamic Armed Group (GIA) that killed eight people and injured about 180.
